finding.Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.

resolution: The generic-api-key detector matched the public Figma file identifier under a credential-like field name. Renamed that metadata field to figmaFile; the identifier remains documented. No secret, value suppression, detector/config change or waiver was added. Final staged/archive scans are separate.
